Games have always been a very difficult industry with a high cost to its workers in terms of crunch & instability. I would love to see more positive visions about how you rebuild an industry stronger using AI, rather than defending the status quo as good and AI is going away.

The discussion of AI in gaming is pernicious now. The idea that games are going to be the only field where humans write code unassisted is obviously wrong. But the push for that means missing a chance to guide AI usage toward approaches that empower workers & help gaming thrive.
We keep relearning some sort of lesson. If only there was a word to describe how bitter it is to learn.
